points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight case packages pass explicit validator and restart files contain state, but the advertised --restart is ignored and metadata falsely denies full mesh retention.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit validator accepts all eight original case packages and report. This structural result does not test restart execution, MPI reconstruction, or numerical credibility.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All cases meet recorded residual thresholds and Re200 reaches t=300 with one inner miss; some steady forces remain materially variable, especially M0.15 inviscid and laminar.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Original M0.15 inviscid Cd crosses zero in its final 10% and laminar Cd changes about 10%; Re20 rank-4/8 Cd differs 2.08914/2.17966 and lift 0.0294/−0.000619. These are material limitations, not proof that the results are synthetic.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Committed report shows residual, force and field images for all cases; Re200 startup Cd≈31 flattens late drag, and steady viscous drag tails are also compressed.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:646–648 incorrectly denies full mesh replication; :1006–1009 labels full viscous traction skin friction and :1345–1357 calls 0.0294 lift close to machine precision and attributes rank differences to round-off without evidence.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report figures and numeric values are present; accepted PDF and original output packages permit review. Several algorithm/memory/force claims do not match source, and figure pixels were not exhaustively rederived.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
